import re

# Test right-aligned behavior
patterns = {
    "old_right": r" *(.+?)",
    "new_non_space": r" *([^ ]+)",
}

test_str = r"hello world foo bar"

for name, pattern in patterns.items():
    print(f"\n=== {name}: {pattern!r} ===")
    pos = 0
    results = []
    while pos < len(test_str):
        m = re.search(pattern, test_str[pos:])
        if not m:
            break
        print(f"  Match at {pos + m.start()}-{pos + m.end()}: group={m.group(1)!r}")
        results.append(m.group(1))
        pos = pos + m.end()
    print(f"  Results: {results}")
